name: Case management (Dynamics 365 Customer Service)
short_description: The Dynamics 365 Customer Service capability that keeps each customer issue in one case record with customer details, activities, routing, service level targets and a recorded resolution.

evidence.quote: That Uhtmer is exactly what Dynamics 365 Case Management fixes.
A case is one record for one customer issue that needs an answer or a fix
case management, omni-channel, AI agents, integration with teams and outlook, and self-service.
